positions.name: ZypherionAnalyticsSelection
positions.frame: what database technology are we selecting for the analytics pipeline and on what performance basis?
positions.why: src-1 declares the adoption of Zypherion for analytics; src-2 gives the performance rationale (15x faster columnar queries); src-4 and src-5 restate the same decision and its performance basis in summary form. One directional read — the selection and its justification — spans all four.

positions.name: ZypherionMigrationTimeline
positions.frame: when does the analytics database migration begin?
positions.why: src-3 states the migration starts next quarter; src-6 pins that to Q3 2026. Both expressions cohere under the single question of the migration's start timing.
